items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 4:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain clearing to the east overnight. Areas of mist and fog patches until later. Isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain/mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then rain on Monday that may be heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
